title: The Empty Glass Case
synopsis: Today the museum will show a new piece of Rome's ancient marble map.
But this morning, its glass case is empty.
goal: Find out when the piece went missing, and what the thief left behind.

options.label: Before 10:00 PM
options.feedback: At 10:00 PM, Enzo saw the piece in its case.

options.label: In the ten dark minutes at midnight
After 6:00 AM
options.feedback: At 6:00 AM, the case was already empty.

notes: Letter: Enzo's night log. The piece was there at 10:00 PM and gone at 6:00 AM; only at midnight could nobody see the hall.

learning.objective: 야간 기록의 시각(PM/AM)을 읽고, 아무도 볼 수 없던 시간을 찾는다.
expressions: The lights went off for ten minutes.
I could not see a thing.

play.title: The Night Log
story: Director Sofia Ferri meets you at the door.
"The new map piece is gone!" she says.
Enzo, the night guard, hands you his log book.
play.letter:
NIGHT LOG — THE MAP HALL
8:00 PM — I locked the hall. The piece was in its case.
10:00 PM — I looked at the case. The piece was there. All quiet.
12:00 AM — The lights went off for ten minutes! I could not see a thing. Then all quiet.
2:00 AM — I sat in the guard room. All quiet.
6:00 AM — I looked at the case. It was EMPTY!
— Enzo
play.question: When did the piece most likely go missing?
hints: Find the last time Enzo saw the piece.
After that, when was the hall too dark to see?
play.successMessage: You found the dark ten minutes!
transition: At midnight, the hall was dark for ten minutes.
Someone could take the piece then, and nobody would see.
Giulia, your guide, waves from the map hall. "Come and look at the floor!"

clue.title: The Dark Ten Minutes
clue.note: The piece was there at 10:00 PM. At midnight, the hall was dark for ten minutes.

evidence.name: Enzo's Night Log
evidence.description: The night guard's log book for the map hall.
evidence.inscription: 12:00 AM — The lights went off for ten minutes!

notes: Letter: Giulia's notes on a trail of white dust, written out of order with starts, ends, after and before.

clueInputs.note: The trail was left in the dark ten minutes.

learning.objective: starts, ends, after, before를 읽고 먼지 자국이 지나간 곳을 순서대로 놓는다.
expressions: It starts at the empty case.
After the case, it goes past the big statue.
Before the back door, it goes down the stairs.

play.title: The Dust Trail
story: On the floor, there is a line of fine white dust.
Livia Conti, a young restorer, kneels down. "Strange," she says softly.
Giulia writes down where the dust goes.
play.letter:
The dust trail ends at the back door.
It starts at the empty case.
After the case, it goes past the big statue.
Before the back door, it goes down the stairs.
play.question: Follow the dust. Put the places in order, from start to end.
hints: One line tells you where the trail starts.
Before the back door means just before the end.
transition: The dust is soft, like chalk. Livia looks at it for a long time.
At the back door, something small is waiting.
play.orderFeedback: Find where the trail starts. Then read After and Before.

clue.title: The Dust Trail
clue.note: A trail of fine white dust runs from the empty case to the back door.

evidence.name: White Dust
evidence.description: Fine white dust from the map hall floor. It is soft, like chalk.

notes: Letter: the Owl's card and the museum's visitor map. The card says where people throw coins; the map says which place that is.

clueInputs.note: The trail ends at the back door, where the card is.

learning.objective: 부엉이 카드의 설명(동전을 던지고 소원을 비는 곳)을 박물관 지도와 맞춰 장소 이름을 쓴다.
expressions: Go where people throw coins and make a wish.

play.title: The Owl's Card
story: Under the back door, there is a small white card.
It has a stamp of an owl on it.
Next to it is a museum visitor map.
play.letterIntro: The owl card and the visitor map say:
play.letter:
THE OWL CARD:
Dear Detective,
The piece is not lost.
Go where people throw coins and make a wish.
Look under the second shell.
— The Owl

THE VISITOR MAP:
PANTHEON — Look up at the round hole in the roof!
TREVI FOUNTAIN — Throw a coin and make a wish!
COLOSSEUM — Walk where the old games were.
play.question: Where does the Owl want you to go?
play.prompt: The Owl wants me to go to the ____ Fountain.
hints: Read the Owl's card. What do people do there?
Find the same words on the visitor map.
transition: The Owl wants you at the fountain of wishes.
"The piece is not lost?" Sofia says. "Then where is it?"
Behind her, Signor Bruno Valli, the show's sponsor, is red in the face.

feedback.PANTHEON: The Pantheon has a hole in its roof. Where do people throw coins?
feedback.COLOSSEUM: The Colosseum is for old games. Where do people make a wish?

play.orderFeedback: Check your spelling on the visitor map.

clue.title: The Owl's Card
clue.value: THE FOUNTAIN OF WISHES · SECOND SHELL
clue.note: The Owl says the piece is not lost, and sends you to the Trevi Fountain.

evidence.name: The Owl Card
evidence.description: A small white card with an owl stamp, left at the back door.
evidence.inscription: The piece is not lost. Look under the second shell.

notes: The Owl put a lock on the light box. Its three numbers are the case's three clues: 4 places on the trail, 3 'All quiet' lines, the second shell.

clueInputs.note: First number: the trail passes 4 places.
Second number: Enzo wrote 'All quiet' 3 times.

learning.objective: 세 단서(먼지 자국, 야간 기록, 부엉이 카드)를 다시 읽어 숫자 4·3·2를 순서대로 맞춘다.
expressions: How many places did my trail pass?
Which shell did I write about?

play.title: The Light Box
story: The big light box is in the guard room.
Someone put a new lock on it, with three dials.
A tag with an owl stamp hangs from the lock.
play.letter:
My lock is made of your first clues, Detective.
First number: How many places did my dust trail pass?
Second number: How many times did Enzo write "All quiet" last night?
Third number: Which shell did I write about on my card?
— The Owl
play.question: Turn the dials to the Owl's three numbers. Then open the light box.
hints: Your notebook has the dust trail. Count its places.
Read Enzo's log again, line by line. Count every "All quiet".
transition: Inside, the big switch is down. There is white dust on it.
Nobody cut the power. Someone turned the lights off by hand.
Sofia goes pale. "So this was a plan."
Giulia holds up the Owl's card. "Then let's follow the Owl. To the Trevi Fountain!"

feedback.422: Count "All quiet" again. Read the midnight line to the end.
feedback.433: Read the Owl's card again. Which shell?
feedback.332: Count the places on the trail again. The empty case is one of them.

play.orderFeedback: Right numbers, wrong order. The trail first, then Enzo's log, then the shell.

evidence.name: The Light Box
evidence.description: The map hall's light box. Its switch was turned off by hand.
evidence.inscription: The switch is down, with white dust on it.

hook: Who is the Owl, and why does the Owl say the piece is not lost?

learningGoal.title: When and where: at midnight, after, before
learningGoal.titleKo: 시간과 순서: at midnight, after, before

intro: Rome. The morning sun is warm on the old stones.
Today the Capitoline Museums will show a new piece of an ancient marble map.
But the glass case is empty!
"Please, Detective," says Director Sofia Ferri. "Help us find it!"
play.caseSummary: The piece went missing at midnight, in ten dark minutes. Someone turned the lights off by hand. A white dust trail led to the back door. There, the Owl left a card: the piece is not lost.

notes: STEP 3-11 trial season (Rome), planned by Claude Code with tool/season_planner/PLAYBOOK.md.
The white dust (s3_ep01_e2) is plaster from the copy Livia carried out: it pays off in Case 03 and Case 04.
Enzo's night log (s3_ep01_e1) is Friday night's. Bruno's Thursday 'lights check' is found in Case 08 and Case 11.
